status: research implementation; official joint procedure not certified

three_two_one.lottery_membership: fixed by seeding position, not by playoff outcome: 10 non-play-in teams (conference seeds 11-15), 4 teams seeded 9th/10th, and the 2 losers of the 7-vs-8 play-in games
three_two_one.floor: relegated (three worst records) cannot receive a pick lower than #12

repeat_restrictions.rule: no team's pick may be #1 in two consecutive drafts or top-5 in three consecutive drafts
repeat_restrictions.identity: native (original) team pick; the restriction follows the pick after a trade

three_two_one.protection_ban: newly traded picks cannot carry top-12 through top-15 protections (the release does not state whether it applies to protections agreed earlier)
three_two_one.picks_17_30: non-lottery teams in inverse order of regular-season record (first round; second round analog per attachment)
three_two_one.second_round: first 16 picks inverse of first-round lottery order; non-lottery teams inverse of record
three_two_one.discipline: league may reduce odds, modify draft position, fine (not modeled)

joint_procedure.primary: sequential_feasible (draw only among teams whose selection keeps a feasible completion, weighted by balls)
joint_procedure.sensitivity: draw_then_adjust (unconstrained weighted order, then floor/min repair)
joint_procedure.validation: sequential_feasible reproduces all 64 printed marginals of the official attachment after rounding (tests/lottery321/test_lottery_rules.py); draw_then_adjust matches within rounding plus Monte Carlo error (tests/lottery321/test_league_sim_dta.py); printed marginals cannot discriminate between procedures

open: boundary ties at the 3rd/4th-worst record: ball and floor allocation
ties among 9/10 seeds and play-in order effects
whether the protection ban applies to protections agreed before 2026-05-28

flattened_2019.drawing: top 4 picks drawn by combination weight without replacement; picks 5-14 in inverse record order
flattened_2019.ties: tied teams split their combined combinations (odd remainder by random draw); applied per simulated state (league_sim.py)
flattened_2019.validation: reproduces official odds rows for worst, 5th-worst and 14th teams exactly to 0.1 pp (tests/lottery321/test_lottery_rules.py::Flattened2019)
